entities.title: The tests
entities.summary: Node's test runner over worker/app.js, with GitHub faked, and over the pure block of index.html that builds Cyberspace's worlds and reads and writes its addresses.
entities.purpose: Checks the Worker's routes, sign-in and door to GitHub without a network or a Cloudflare account, and Cyberspace without a browser: its addresses, the cities, towers, streets and skylines its world builders make, the draw calls the Layers panel counts, and its labels' contrast.
boundaries: Tests the Worker, and of index.html the block between /* space-world:start */ and /* space-world:end */, run in node:vm, and the two :root blocks and the label rules, read as text for the contrast test; nothing here drives a browser.
GitHub is a fake fetch; the secrets are test values.
